messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 16):
"""
Name of the Cover or Plan or Option or Add-on or Rider Amount of Deductible@ % of Deductible© Min Max Min Max @Furnish the applicable information 3.4 Co-pay allowed Whether Mandatory Yes / No Mention details separately for each cover or option Sl. No. Name of the Cover or Plan or Option or Rider or Addon Amount of Co-pay@ % of Co-pay@ Min Max Min Max @Furnish the applicable information 3.5 Sub-limits, if any (Mention separately for each Cover or Plan or Option or Rider or Addon) Contingency Sub-Limits as a % of SI, if applicable Sub limits in fixed rupee terms, if applicable S No Item Particulars (to be filled in by insurer) 3.6 Whether cancellation (other than free-look) by the insured allowed:
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}
